questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion for emphasis in a hypothetical scenario where the speaker believes an action would be unethical?
options: It was only when she realised the consequences that she stopped arguing.
Only if he had known the truth would he have acted differently.
Had he been told the full situation, he would have left immediately.
The fact that she was certain of his guilt made her question his motives.
questions.answer: Had he been told the full situation, he would have left immediately.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence correctly restates the speaker’s observation about the most important factor in a successful negotiation?
options: The thing that matters most in negotiations is the ability to listen actively.
Active listening is the thing that is most important in negotiations.
Most important in negotiations is the ability to listen actively.
What is important in negotiations is listening actively, but not necessarily listening well.
questions.answer: The thing that matters most in negotiations is the ability to listen actively.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive to express a hypothetical situation where the speaker believes an alternative outcome is possible?
options: If she were to win the award, she would be very happy.
If she wins the award, she would be very happy.
She would be very happy if she wins the award.
She would be happy if she were to win the award, but she doesn’t think she will.
questions.answer: If she were to win the award, she would be very happy.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs ellipsis to maintain the intended meaning of a formal academic discussion while omitting redundant information?
options: The study, which was conducted over two years, revealed significant findings on climate change impacts.
The study, conducted over two years, revealed significant findings on climate change impacts.
The study revealed significant findings on climate change impacts; it was conducted over two years.
Significant findings on climate change impacts were revealed by the study, which lasted two years.
questions.answer: The study, conducted over two years, revealed significant findings on climate change impacts.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a formal register and correctly structures a nuanced conditional to express regret at not having taken an opportunity?
options: If only I had known she was coming, I would have invited her to dinner.
Had I known she was coming, I would have invited her to dinner.
I wish I had known she was coming, so I could have invited her.
If she had known I was coming, I would have invited her to dinner.
questions.answer: If only I had known she was coming, I would have invited her to dinner.
